---
title: "SDTM Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')`"
output: 
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc_float: true
params:
  report_data: NA
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* 美化H2标题 */
h2 {
  background-color: #334155;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-top: 30px;
}

/* 自定义提示框样式 */
.alert-success {
  background-color: #d1fae5;
  color: #065f46;
  padding: 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border-left: 5px solid #10b981;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.alert-warning {
  background-color: #fef3c7;
  color: #92400e;
  padding: 15px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border-left: 5px solid #f59e0b;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}


table.dataTable {
  font-size: 14px;
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)


df <- params$report_data

# 数据预处理：如果数据为空，创建空数据框以防报错
if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
  df <- data.frame(
    Row = character(), Variable = character(), Original_Value = character(),
    Rule_ID = character(), Message = character(), Severity = character(), Domain = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


df_error <- df %>% filter(Severity == "Error")
df_suggestion <- df %>% filter(Severity != "Error")

```

## **1. Summary**

**Total number of errors:** `r nrow(df_error)` | **Total number of suggestions:** `r nrow(df_suggestion)`

```{r summary-table}
if (nrow(df_error) > 0) {
  summary_df <- df_error %>%
    group_by(Rule_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = n(),
      Domains = paste(unique(Domain), collapse = ", "),
      Variables = paste(unique(Variable), collapse = ", ")
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Count))

  knitr::kable(summary_df, format = "markdown", align = "c")
} else {
  cat("<div class='alert-success'>✨ No errors were found! ✨</div>")
}
```

---

## **2. Detailed Error Log**

```{r error-table}
if (nrow(df_error) > 0) {
  datatable(
    df_error,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = 'top',
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = 'caption-side: top; text-align: left; color: #b91c1c; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;',
      'Error Details (Use column filters above to subset by Domain, Variable, etc.)'
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 20,
      autoWidth = TRUE,
      dom = 'Bfrtip',
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = 'dt-center', targets = c(0, 3, 5, 6))
      )
    ),
    colnames = c("Row", "Variable", "Original Value", "Rule ID", "Message", "Severity", "Domain")
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = c('Severity'),
      color = 'red',
      fontWeight = 'bold'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = c('Rule_ID'),
      backgroundColor = '#f8fafc'
    )
} else {
  cat("<div class='alert-success'>🌟 No error records to display.</div>")
}
```

---

## **3. Suggestions & Tips Log**

*This section captures non-mandatory suggestions and tips for improving data quality.*

```{r suggestion-table}

df_suggestion <- df_suggestion %>% select(Rule_ID, Message, Severity, Domain)
if (nrow(df_suggestion) > 0) {
  datatable(
    df_suggestion,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = 'top',
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = 'caption-side: top; text-align: left; color: #0369a1; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;',
      'Suggestion Details'
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 20,
      autoWidth = TRUE,
      dom = 'Bfrtip',
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = 'dt-center', targets = c(0, 2, 3))
      )
    ),
    colnames = c("Rule ID", "Message", "Severity", "Domain")
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = c('Severity'),
      color = '#0284c7',
      fontWeight = 'bold'
    )
} else {
  cat("✨ No suggestions were found! ✨")
}
```
